metric.name: frame_p95_ms
metric.sql_used:
INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.frames.timeline;
WITH
  window_frames AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.upid, f.ui_thread_utid, a.id, a.dur, a.jank_type
    FROM android_frames_layers AS f
    JOIN actual_frame_timeline_slice AS a ON a.id = f.actual_frame_timeline_id
    WHERE f.layer_name NOT GLOB '*SurfaceView*' AND a.dur > 0
  ),
  app AS (
    SELECT upid FROM window_frames GROUP BY upid ORDER BY count(*) DESC, upid LIMIT 1
  ),
  frames AS (
    SELECT * FROM window_frames WHERE upid = (SELECT upid FROM app)
  ),
  ranked AS (
    SELECT dur AS ns, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY dur) AS rank, count(*) OVER () AS n
    FROM frames
  )
SELECT (SELECT ns / 1e6 FROM ranked WHERE rank = (n * 95 + 99) / 100) AS value

claims.text: The app's frame p95 improved from baseline to current rather than regressing.

claims.text: The only checked metric that worsened was main-thread blocked time, but its selected UI process was the Nexus Launcher rather than com.superplayer.demo, so it does not localize a regression to the app.

citations.sql:
INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.frames.timeline;
WITH
  window_frames AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.upid, f.ui_thread_utid, a.id, a.dur, a.jank_type
    FROM android_frames_layers AS f
    JOIN actual_frame_timeline_slice AS a ON a.id = f.actual_frame_timeline_id
    WHERE f.layer_name NOT GLOB '*SurfaceView*' AND a.dur > 0
  ),
  app AS (
    SELECT upid FROM window_frames GROUP BY upid ORDER BY count(*) DESC, upid LIMIT 1
  ),
  frames AS (
    SELECT * FROM window_frames WHERE upid = (SELECT upid FROM app)
  ),
  main_thread AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ui_thread_utid AS utid FROM frames
  ),
  work AS (
    SELECT s.ts, s.dur
    FROM slice AS s
    JOIN thread_track AS t ON t.id = s.track_id
    WHERE t.utid IN (SELECT utid FROM main_thread)
      AND s.depth = 0 AND s.dur > 0
      AND s.name NOT GLOB 'Choreographer#doFrame*'
  ),
  blocked AS (
    SELECT ts, dur
    FROM thread_state
    WHERE utid IN (SELECT utid FROM main_thread)
      AND dur > 0 AND state NOT IN ('Running', 'R', 'R+')
  )
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM thread_state WHERE utid IN (SELECT utid FROM main_thread)
    ) THEN NULL
    ELSE coalesce((
      SELECT sum(min(b.ts + b.dur, w.ts + w.dur) - max(b.ts, w.ts))
      FROM blocked AS b
      JOIN work AS w ON b.ts < w.ts + w.dur AND w.ts < b.ts + b.dur
    ), 0) / 1e6
  END AS value

claims.text: The range's head commit is a rename of the feed handler identifier in FeedScreen.kt, with no trace evidence tying it to a performance change.

caveats: Each side has only one capture, so small metric movements can be run-to-run noise.
The traces were captured on an Android emulator (sdk_gphone64_arm64, SDK 36).
The blocked-time metric selected the process with the most window frames, which was Nexus Launcher in these captures rather than the demo app.
